notes.title: tERRORbane is the Best Italian Game 2023!
notes.notes:
What a night! During the Italian Game Awards, tERRORbane was awarded the prestigious Best Italian Game award for the year 2023!

It's been a while since The Dev welcomed our first Players through the initial blue screen, and what a bug-filled journey we've shared.
For us at BitNine Studio, tERRORbane was like opening the chaos of our minds to a world of curious explorers, and we have been learning so much from you all ever since.

We couldn't have made it without you Players. So say the Devs.

And naturally a great big thank you to IIDEA (Italian Interactive Digital Entertainment Association) and the beautiful people of the international jury panel that awarded us with this incredible honor.
Another thank must go to the awesome Italian community of devs that have supported us throughout the years and to the guys at WhisperGames, who believed in us and helped tERRORbane reach the world.

Last but not least, we would like to thank our families and friends, who listened to our ideas, tested broken builds and generally enabled us to reach for our dreams.

Keep tuned, people. BitNine has a lot more in store for you to play.

Never forget to stay awesome,
Andrea, Matteo and Luca.

notes.title: LANGUAGE UPDATE!
notes.notes:
SUMMER! 
The season of simmering GPUs and malfunctioning CPUs, did you have fun?

We certainly hope you did! So much so, in fact, that we have prepared a fitting gift to welcome you back to the world of TB after your very well-earned vacations...


Cue in the tERRORbane LANGUAGE UPDATE!

In this upcoming free update our top of the line voice engineers (It's actually us, but imagine us with a lab coat or something.) have selected the finest of voice-over artists to provide their talent to the game:

It is with immense pleasure that I present you the new official Japanese voice of the Developer: Mr. Tomokazu Sugita (杉田 智和)!
Many of you will remember him for his incredibly influential roles in Anime and Videogames, like Gintoki in Gintama or Ragna The Bloodedge in BlazBlue. Did I mention we're big fans?

We'll also have the incredible talent of Sen Zhong-Ren (森中人) as the Chinese voice of the Dev, and Yours Truly (Andrea Leoni) nagging you again as the Italian voice-over option for our favourite computer genius/disaster.

Russian and Traditional Chinese players will also be able to enjoy the game in their preferred text language.

Our top of the line gameplay experts (Yup, still us three. Imagine us with taped-up nerd glasses this time.) also included a complete rebalancing of the gameplay objectives to make achieving the True Ending that much more enjoyable, as well as some new visual aids to help understand your place and progression in the world of tERRORbane better.
Oh, and a new door that will bring you directly to the casino stealth section through the WARP ZONE. ;)


Look forward to the upcoming patch launching right on time for this year's Tokyo Game Show, on all our supported platforms!

notes.title: tERRORbane x Seventh Lair
notes.notes:
Heya Folks!

tERRORbane's big moment is just around the corner, but while we are prepping everything for our glitchy release, our friends at NOVECT, talented creators of the highly-acclaimed 'The House in Fata Morgana' are releasing something you might find deceptively familiar:

'Seventh Lair' is a game about Dark†Knight, a 27 years old indie game developer beginning to grow apprehensive about his lack of success in life. He is on the bottom rung of society and his career hangs on by a thread, with internet trolls taking their turn bashing his creations even on his own website, until something positive happens: a very enthusiastic female fan reaches out.

"I'll have a new release on April Fool's" announces our developer, but on the day of release something strange occurs and he finds himself drawn into an RPG-like realm...! 
Play through a tongue-in-cheek, but emotional journey that takes a look at the online interactions between an indie game developer and fans!

"A true masterpiece doesn't ask permission to move people."

でしょう?

'Seventh Lair' is available NOW on Steam.

notes.title: "tERRORbane: an INTRODUCTION, mostly" launch!
notes.notes:
Hey Folks! 
Have you been trying our demo?
Have you ever wanted to give us and other Steam users feedback about it?
 
The Developer came up with a plan for you to be able to do just that! 

On the 13th of October we will launch the current demo as a separate product titled “tERRORbane: an INTRODUCTION, mostly” so you can leave reviews, rate the experience and create guides for the community! 
This, unfortunately, also means that we'll be [b]discontinuing the demo[/b] and removing it from our page. If you have already played it, you will have to download it again and start a new game… 

...but wait right there, you can [b]keep your saved data[/b] if you want! You can follow these simple instructions to migrate your save data to the new application:

[h3]Step 1[/h3]
locate your saved data folder in "C:\Users\<username>\AppData\LocalLow\BitNine Studio\tERRORbane - Demo" and make a backup of the data1.bns and data2.bns files you find inside.
[h3]Step 2[/h3]
When the new product releases and you'll have it installed in your computer go to "C:\Users\<username>\AppData\LocalLow\BitNine Studio\tERRORbane - an Introduction, mostly" and replace the files inside with your backed up copy from step 1.

And there it is! You can resume your Demo adventure right where you left it.

[b]ATTENTION![/b] If you have files in you computer from older versions of the demo that did not have the new Chinese and Japanese translations, in some rare cases you may have trouble with your data if you now want to switch to another localization.
If you've been playing in a language but now wish to switch to a new one we highly recommend to start a fresh new game.

While you wait for the release of the full game, have fun with “tERRORbane: an INTRODUCTION, mostly” and let us know what you think about it!

Here is the link: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1773410/tERRORbane_an_INTRODUCTION_mostly/]tERRORbane: an INTRODUCTION, mostly[/url]

It is with great pleasure that we announce that tERRORbane will also feature an official [b]German[/b], [b]French[/b], [b]Russian[/b], [b]Simplified and Traditional Chinese[/b] and [b]Japanese[/b] localization, to go along with the already existing English and Italian ones!

notes.title: We're on Steam! (And coming to Nintendo Switch sometime later too)
notes.notes:
Wow, we're here on Steam! Hey everyone!

It's been quite the adventure, but we're in the final stages of development, so you won't have to wait for release for long. 

We're wrapping up the process and can't wait to show you the crazy trip that is tERRORbane. 
To give you a sneak peak and get you hyped up, we've prepared[b] a new announcement trailer![/b]

Watch it here:
[previewyoutube=kPKZMuH3V0M;full][/previewyoutube]

It would mean the world to us if you'd[b] wishlist[/b] the game (telling your friends would straight up [b]blow our freaking minds[/b])
